milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the white wall banners on the south exterior wall of the building and face toward them to confirm visual discovery. Three banners are placed at spawn-relative (4,2,5), (6,2,5), and (5,3,5) — target is set to (5,2,5) as the cluster center. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing range along the cobblestone path, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is genuinely looking at the banners rather than passing by accidentally.

milestones.task: trade for Any color blank banner
milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because trading with the shepherd villager produces a white_banner item that ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with 16 emeralds and 0 banners, so detecting at least 1 white_banner in inventory confirms a successful trade. A white_banner is a blank banner (no patterns applied) which satisfies 'Any color blank banner'. There are no other banner sources in the scene — wall banners are blocks that cannot be picked up without tools the player doesn't have.
